title: docs: prepare all 39 packages and website for official v3.3.0 release
body:
Repo is shipping v3.3.0 as its first official release, but package metadata, READMEs, docs site, and root-level files are in an inconsistent pre-release state (4 empty `description`s, missing `keywords`/`repository`/`homepage`/`bugs`/`publishConfig`/`files` on most packages, duplicate `[Unreleased]` CHANGELOG sections, `ROADMAP.md` header reading `v0.5.x`, stale refs to deleted files, and a half-Chinese `QUICK_REFERENCE.md` violating the English-only rule).

### Package metadata (all 39 packages)
- Filled missing `description` for `layout`, `plugin-ai`, `plugin-report`, `plugin-workflow`.
- Merged common + per-package `keywords`.
- Normalized `license: MIT`, `author`, `repository` (`git+` URL + `directory`), `bugs`, `homepage`, `publishConfig: { access: public }`, `files: [dist, README.md, CHANGELOG.md, LICENSE]`.
- Created missing per-package `LICENSE` and `CHANGELOG.md` files.
- `private: true` `vscode-extension` skips `publishConfig`/`files`.
- `homepage` points to the real docs section (`plugins/`, `layout/`, `utilities/`, …) rather than a blanket `/docs/packages/<name>`.

### README standardization (all 39 READMEs)
Idempotent marker `<!-- release-metadata:v3.3.0 -->` followed by `## Compatibility` / `## Links` / `## License` appended before the existing final License heading; existing hand-written content preserved. Stale `spec v2.0.1` reference in `packages/types/README.md` bumped to `v3.3.0`.

### Website docs (`content/docs/`)
- New `guide/release-notes.md` with highlights and compatibility matrix.
- Plugin page stubs for the five packages that had none: `plugin-ai`, `plugin-designer`, `plugin-list`, `plugin-report`, `plugin-workflow`.
- `guide/meta.json` and `plugins/meta.json` re-synced with the filesystem (dropped non-existent `console-rendering`, added `plugin-development`, `building-crud-app`, `release-notes`, all 21 plugin pages).
- Stale `spec v3.0.0` → `v3.3.0` in `architecture-overview.md`.

### Root-level
- `CHANGELOG.md` — collapsed two duplicate `[Unreleased]` blocks into `## [3.3.0] - 2026-04-17` with release-highlights intro; empty `[Unreleased]` stub re-added at top; Keep-a-Changelog note hoisted to the intro.
- `ROADMAP.md` — header bumped (`v0.5.x` → `v3.3.0`, `35` → `39` packages, last-updated `2026-04-17`).
- Root `README.md` — "What's New" rewritten for v3.3.0; removed links to 5 deleted files (`MIGRATION_GUIDE.md`, `PHASE3_IMPLEMENTATION.md`, `ARCHITECTURE_EVALUATION.md`, `OBJECTSTACK_SPEC_ALIGNMENT.md`, `CONSOLE_PLUGIN_DOCS_INDEX.md`).
- `QUICK_REFERENCE.md` — replaced; old content referenced several deleted files and mixed Chinese throughout (Rule #-1 violation). New version is a plain English cheat-sheet covering commands, layout, package tiers, and current compatibility.

### Out of scope
No version bumps (changesets concern), no feature/test/build changes, `packages/components/src/ui/**` untouched.
